tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by government of karnataka

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Minimum five years up to FY 2025-26 experience in deploying Manpower personnel to State Government Departments, State Government Undertakings Certificates by competent authorities should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal in support of meeting this requirement

Disbursed Annual salary payments of not less than Rs.25.lakh to various categories of personnel in otheroffices as stated in (a) above in one or more contracts in any one of the last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 This should be Certified by a Chartered Accountant and the certificate should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal

The tenders should have executed at least two service contracts copy of contract or certificate from concernedorganization institute may be furnished and uploaded during the last five years i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26., to similar organizations as detailed in a above Certificates by competent authorities should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal in support of meeting this requirement
